title: Toward Agents That Reason About Their Computation
abstract: arXiv:2510.22833v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While reinforcement learning agents can achieve superhuman performance in many complex tasks, they typically do not become more computationally efficient as they improve. In contrast, humans gradually require less cognitive effort as they become more proficient at a task. If agents could reason about their compute as they learn, could they similarly reduce their computation footprint? If they could, we could have more energy efficient agents or free up compute cycles for other processes like planning. In this paper, we experiment with showing agents the cost of their computation and giving them the ability to control when they use compute. We conduct our experiments on the Arcade Learning Environment, and our results demonstrate that with the same training compute budget, agents that reason about their compute perform better on 75% of games. translated_title: 迈向能对自身计算进行推理的智能体
translated_abstract: 虽然强化学习智能体在许多复杂任务中可以取得超越人类的性能，但随着其能力的提升，它们的计算效率通常并不会随之提高。相比之下，人类在任务上越熟练，所需的认知努力就越少。如果智能体在学习过程中能够对其计算进行推理，它们是否也能类似地减少计算占用？如果可以，我们就能拥有更节能的智能体，或者为规划等其他过程释放计算资源。在本文中，我们通过实验向智能体展示其计算成本，并赋予它们控制何时使用计算的能力。我们在街机学习环境上进行实验，结果表明在相同的训练计算预算下，能够对其计算进行推理的智能体在75%的游戏中表现更好。此外，这些智能体平均使用的计算量减少了三倍。我们对各个游戏进行了分析。
tldr: 本文通过让强化学习智能体感知自身计算成本并自主控制计算使用时机，实现了在相同训练预算下于75%的游戏中性能更优、且平均计算量减少三倍的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that reinforcement learning agents that reason about their computation cost and control when to use compute perform better on 75% of ALE games while using three times less compute on average.
